# Research Implementations

This directory is reserved for vendored research code that is useful as an
algorithm reference but should not be imported by FinsSim runtime modules until
it has been ported to the current Python/TorchRL stack.

Do not add TensorFlow 1.x, legacy Gym, MPI, or MuJoCo-only requirements from
these projects to `python/finssim_marl/pyproject.toml`.
